**Regime: Risk-premium dominance; yield rises punish rather than reward—classic stress/unwind setup.**

**Inflection spots:**

- **AUD & NZD short-term unwind risk.** Both sit at extreme carry crowding (92nd, 74th percentile) on yield-stress regimes (real 10Y correlation negative: -0.22, -0.23). Valuation is the sole pillar prop; fundamentals near-neutral or soft. Vol spike = fast unwind.
- **GBP at the edge.** Carry crowded (97th), yields decoupled, valuation stretched (+1.6). Real 10Y multiple is weak (-0.08 effective reward). Fragile positioning into quiet vol.
- **CAD inflecting the other way.** Cheap (-1.2) with fundamentals improving (+0.4); external pillar strong (+1.65). Mean reversion anchor; a natural bid if risk stabilizes.

**Carry standout:** **AUD/JPY** — both carry-rich but on opposite stress reads. AUD yield-punished, JPY policy-supported into BoJ hold; pair vulnerable to unwind if vol spikes or duration reprices.
